# Chapter 2: Supply and demand

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/exercise-system/exercise-system.css" />
<div id="quiz1" class="exercise-system-root">Loading practice questions …</div>
<script type="module">
  import { mount } from "./assets/exercise-system/exercise-system.js";
  import { assessment, questions } from "./assets/exercise-system/quiz1.js";

  const el = document.getElementById("quiz1");
  try {
    mount(el, { assessment, questions });
  } catch (err) {
    el.textContent = "Could not load the practice questions: " + err.message;
    console.error(err);
  }
</script>
```
